title: His brother Tom and Werlein's
summary: Riddick shows his oldest brother Tom, a sales manager at Werlein's piano department who got him to New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: My brother Tom, my oldest brother. Mm-hmm. Tom's wife. These other people, I don't remember who they are. Now, this is Tom's wife right here.
I found Tom in the city directory, by the way. Tom Riddick. Thomas M. Riddick. Yeah. And he was working at Whirlines as a sales manager.
Yeah, he was a sales manager for the piano department at Whirlines.
Well, no wonder you got a job. That got you in right away.
He got me over to New Orleans, and after that, I didn't care. I never did like Whirlines. I never was crazy about Whirlines. Sidney Bechet.
